description: Source code for sensing sensor management in Zephyr OS, including functions to open, close, configure, and retrieve sensor info.

methods.name: sensing_open_sensor
methods.description: Opens a sensing sensor based on sensor info and registers callbacks.

methods.name: sensing_open_sensor_by_dt
methods.description: Opens a sensing sensor using device tree information and registers callbacks.

methods.name: sensing_set_config
methods.description: Sets configuration parameters for a sensing sensor.

methods.name: sensing_get_config
methods.description: Retrieves configuration parameters from a sensing sensor.

methods.name: sensing_get_sensor_info
methods.description: Retrieves information about a sensing sensor.
